provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / Copernicus / Google; CloudFerro source file hosting
api_version: JRC Global Surface Water 1.5; long-term aggregated occurrence 1984-2024; corrected 2026-11-10

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation and offline preflight ONLY: no provider GET, HEAD, HTTP Range, automated listing/asset download, pagination, streaming, crawling, retries, caller-selected path, query string, host, product family, period, header or redirect is authorized by this contract. The exact selected v1.5 occurrence asset is occurrence_10E_50N_v1_5_2024.tif. The existing scripts/preflight_jrc_gsw_v15_listing_v0.py accepts separately and lawfully acquired, full original UTF-8 listing bytes with no network request. First review CloudFerro endpoint/service terms, provider access conditions, bounded request/redirect/rate policy and corrected-asset version identity. Then separately propose a fixed provider runner; do not change status to probe_ready solely on a successful HTML source-page request.

response_contract.format: Original public CloudFerro JRC GSW v1.5 UTF-8 relative-path listing, and after separate review one exact v1.5 10-degree occurrence GeoTIFF. The offline listing preflight only checks the fixed asset path, listing syntax and original listing SHA-256; it does not examine GeoTIFF bytes, verify source pixel values or compute original whole-TIFF checksum.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Occurrence represents a historical observed-water occurrence percentage over available valid Landsat observations, not event flood hazard, annual exceedance probability, inundation return period, modelled flood extent, or insured damage. v1.5 aggregates Landsat Collection 1 (1984-2021) and Collection 2 (2022-2024), with geolocation/co-registration seams which can exceed one approximately 30 m cell; the 1984-2015 research-vetted record and subsequent extensions have different validation. Official original Occurrence GeoTIFFs and GEE assets were corrected 2026-11-10 for sporadic >100% out-of-range values, so stale cached tiles must be rejected. Monthly Recurrence has a separately acknowledged unresolved sparse-observation bias; it is NOT cleared by the Occurrence correction. Historic water masks cannot alone be promoted to flood-frequency or CAT-model input without CRS, nodata, class semantics, temporal availability, independent validation and loss-model fit.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: The JRC publisher allows download and reuse, but no reviewed machine-client/API service terms, CloudFerro anonymous GET/HEAD/Range limits, byte-range acceptance, redirect policy, server-advertised usage quotas, or automated polling entitlement has been bound to this exact service. Zero executable requests under this contract; no bulk mirror, tiled crawl or surprise downloads.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Pin exact 1984-2024 v1.5 product, tile, path, layer, and provider’s 2026-11-10 corrected occurrence publication; a filename alone does not prove the corrected bytes. Before any data request, independently verify source directory listing integrity and choose a currently corrected tile. Later original response receipt must include full original byte count/hash (or a clearly scoped Range-only hash), COG/TIFF header, raster type/CRS/NoData, retrieval UTC and explicit cache freshness. v1.4 FTP source is deprecated and not interchangeable.

rights_and_policy.notes: The official JRC Global Surface Water download page, reviewed 2026-11-13, states that Copernicus Programme data are free without restriction of use and requires acknowledgement/citation and map attribution 'Source: EC JRC/Google' with Pekel et al. (2016). This product-scoped reuse allowance includes commercial analysis in principle; it is NOT a reviewed grant for arbitrary automated CloudFerro asset crawling, provider transfer limits, unqualified republishing of third-party content, unverified historical/corrected versions, or CAT scientific admission. Service/API terms and source byte persistence/public redistribution remain independently unresolved and fail-closed until reviewed.
